title: A connector's run
description: What POST /api/v1/connectors/{name}/runs answers. A poll answers its task: 201 for one made now, and 200 for one already in flight. A folder answers 202 with the due time that the scheduler scans it at. A retry under the same Idempotency-Key answers 200 with the first answer.

task_id.description: The poll's task, which a worker holding poll:<source> claims.
